title: tunnelmind:data_model:v1 — AIT constraints
description: Validates the `constraints` object of an ATAP v0.1 AIT declared under the tunnelmind:data_model:v1 profile. The canonical-byte serialization of `constraints` MUST NOT exceed 4096 bytes (ATAP v0.1 §6.2).

model_id.description: The one model lineage this AIT witnesses. Every drafted, published and assessed version in the chain carries this model_id, so one receipt is the full life story of one model.

allowed_sources.description: Source identifiers the models may be built from or compiled against (e.g. cisco-ise-3.3, meraki-dashboard-api-v1, tunnelmind-scry). A drafted event citing any other source breaks the constraint.

required_gates.description: The gates a version must pass, in this chain, before a `published` event. Fixed at all four in v1.

fixture_policy.description: fixture_only: every gate and re-run executes against a pinned, hashed fixture. fixture_then_live: fixture runs are required; live runs are permitted in addition, within max_live_reruns_per_day.

max_live_reruns_per_day.description: Ceiling on gate runs against a live source per UTC day, across all triggers. Protects vendor API rate limits and the operator's spend.

min_assessor_tier_for_rerun.description: Lowest assessor attestation tier whose reproducible assessment triggers a free re-run. Assessments below it are recorded and may trigger a paid re-run only.

models.description: The model each agent role runs on. Keys are agent roles; human roles run no model.
